data.design: Familiar Silcoon cocoon silhouette. Pale blue frozen silk, cold white highlights, blue shading, small golden eye. Read as frozen silk rather than a carved crystal. No new anatomy, sea connection or healing that resurrects companions.
data.dex_entry: It seals itself in silk glazed with frost. Even when its shell lies perfectly still, a faint scratching can be heard from within.

moves.description: On evolution. Entry hazards offer indirect pressure without a damaging attack.
moves.name: Spikes

moves.description: Level 10 in the species learnset. Delayed healing can reach a teammate switched into its position.

description:
Frostcoon seals itself in silk glazed with frost. The shell can lie perfectly still while faint scratching continues inside. Raising this companion asks for patience: it supports others rather than attacking, long before its late evolution.

Slow defensive support with Wish, screens, weather and hazards; no damaging moves in its authored level-up list. Its eventual level-55 evolution rewards the long branch.

Shell Armor prevents critical hits; it does not erase the severe Fire/Rock weaknesses or cure status. Becoming Frostcoon replaces inherited attacks with available support moves while preserving chosen support moves and spent PP. This transition matters when comparing it with Glaciverm: the cocoon is deliberately unable to rely on its larval attacks.

Proposed ecology: silk anchors the cocoon under a branch where wind cannot roll it. The scratching grows irregular when its support is shaken, then settles after the branch is still. A companion-care moment could involve choosing a secure resting place and waiting for that ordinary sound, without a new hidden bond meter, healing power or evolution requirement.

Proposed woodland placement and care: a cocoon hangs inside the sheltered fork that its larval form used, above the trampled path. A wind-fallen occupied branch presents a small choice: prop it into the nearby fork, leave it alone, or take the longer way around. The response is audible scratching that settles, not a reward dispensed by the animal. A traveling companion can attach to a padded branch rest; the familiar scratching helps the player recognize it through the long, outwardly still stage.

links.description: Proposed habitat: sheltered branch forks above the path, occasionally brought down by wind. These are possible observations and care encounters; raising regional Wurmple remains the established acquisition route.
Regional Pokédex; later species amendments §§21–29 and pond revision §32.
